# docs/superpowers/

SDKWork superpowers specifications and migration design documents.

## Purpose

This directory contains detailed migration design documents, architecture decision records, and specification drafts for large-scale sdkwork-commerce alignment work.

## Owner

sdkwork-commerce repository maintainers.

## Allowed Content

- Migration design documents.
- Architecture decision records.
- Specification drafts and review notes.

## Forbidden Content

- Generated SDK output.
- Source code or implementation files.
- Secrets, credentials, or runtime state.
